maya (finance): heads up — Akasha Corp invoice for 02/28 is ~14,200 tokens higher than what the dashboard shows. noticed via EOM recon script.
sam (support): ugh, ok. is that across a single line item or totals mismatch?
liz (customer-success): saw a ticket from Akasha this morning, they also flagged a weird 'reserved burst' charge line.
maya (finance): it's showing as a separate line: `reserved-burst: akasha-prod` — dashboard has no reserved-burst usage for them. totals differ by 14,213 tokens.
sam (support): do we have an idempotency/retry window that could double-count? any ingest backfills?
kevin (eng): not on retries. quick scan of the ingest logs shows a background embed batch that ran right at 00:02 UTC on 02/28 for tenant akasha — the job wrote to the billable_events table and also triggered the async meterer. possible double-write.
kevin (eng): snippet from logs: ```INFO 2026-02-28T00:02:12Z embed-backfill tenant=akasha job=background-embed batch_id=bb-447 processed=3214 tokens=14213 wrote_events=true async_meter_triggered=true```
sam (support): if the async meter triggered, dashboard pipeline might have dedup logic but billing ingest consumed raw events.
maya (finance): how do we confirm that double-write? can we replay or run a dedupe query?
kevin (eng): run this quick check to find duplicate event signatures: ```sql
SELECT signature, count(*) FROM billable_events
WHERE tenant_id = 'akasha' AND created_at >= '2026-02-28'::date
GROUP BY signature HAVING count(*) > 1;
```
kevin (eng): if that shows signatures with count=2 and sum(tokens)=14213 for those, that's our answer.
liz (customer-success): should we put the invoice on hold for Akasha while we investigate?
maya (finance): yes please, don't collect payments until we confirm. I'll flag it as disputed in billing system.
sam (support): I'll run the query now and paste results.
sam (support): (3m later) query shows two signatures matching that batch_id: signature=bb-447-2026 hash, count=2, tokens_total=14213.
kevin (eng): confirms double-write. root cause: background-embed job both emitted synchronous meter events and queued an async meterer that also consumed the same records — race condition in the job wrapper. we've seen this pattern with newer backfill runner.
kevin (eng): short-term fix: run a dedupe delete where duplicate signatures exist and mark the async-metered rows as tombstoned. long-term: patch backfill wrapper to emit a single event or set an atomic flag.
maya (finance): what's the impact if we delete the duplicates? will accounting still match?
kevin (eng): deleting duplicate event rows will reduce billed tokens by exactly 14,213 for Akasha for that window. we keep the canonical single row. i'll prepare a safe delete and a dry-run first.
sam (support): can you paste the dry-run SQL? i'll attach to the support ticket so customers can see we ran checks.
kevin (eng): dry-run: ```sql
WITH dup AS (
  SELECT id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY signature ORDER BY created_at) as rn
  FROM billable_events
  WHERE tenant_id='akasha' AND created_at >= '2026-02-28'::date
)
SELECT count(*) as rows_to_remove, sum(tokens) as tokens_to_remove
FROM dup WHERE rn > 1;
```
kevin (eng): real delete (run after approval): ```sql
WITH dup AS (
  SELECT id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY signature ORDER BY created_at) as rn
  FROM billable_events
  WHERE tenant_id='akasha' AND created_at >= '2026-02-28'::date
)
DELETE FROM billable_events WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM dup WHERE rn > 1);
```
maya (finance): please include an audit row and reference in the invoice adjustments. we'll need a short explanation for Akasha and our accounting team.
kevin (eng): will add audit log to bill_adjustments table with before/after counts and reference to job id.
sam (support): tentative plan: 1) hold invoice (maya) 2) run dry-run and paste output (kevin) 3) run deletion during maintenance window and create adjustment (kevin/maya) 4) tell customer and close ticket (liz/sam).
liz (customer-success): i'll draft the customer message: apologize, explain duplicate-meter bug, note refund/credit if needed, ETA 48h.
maya (finance): agreed. also can we add a monitoring alert to catch when async_meter_triggered=true and wrote_events=true in same job?
kevin (eng): yeah i'll add an alert and a small audit job to scan for duplicate signatures weekly.
sam (support): anything else we need before executing? approvals?
maya (finance): finance approves the deletion and adjustment once kevin posts dry-run numbers and the audit plan.
kevin (eng): posting dry-run results now in the ticket.```
